title: Greeting and Thanksgiving for the Thessalonians

questions.question: Paul, Silvanus, and ____ send this letter to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace."

questions.question: They give thanks to God always for them all, remembering before our God and Father their work of faith and labor of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:3 (ESV): "remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Paul remembers their steadfastness of ____ in our Lord Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:3 (ESV): "remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power and in the ____ and with full conviction.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:5 (ESV): "because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with full conviction."

questions.question: You became ____ of us and of the Lord, for you received the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Spirit.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:6 (ESV): "And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you received the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: They received the word in much ____, with the joy of the Holy Spirit.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:6 (ESV): "And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you received the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: So that they became an example to all the believers in ____ and in Achaia.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:7 (ESV): "so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia."

questions.question: For not only has the word of the Lord sounded forth from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone forth ____.
options: to the ends of the earth
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:8 (ESV): "For not only has the word of the Lord sounded forth from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone forth everywhere, so that we need not say anything."

questions.question: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of reception we had among you, and how you initially turned to God from ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:9 (ESV): "For they themselves report concerning us the kind of reception we had among you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,"

questions.question: You turned to God to serve the living and true God, and to ____ for his Son from heaven.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:10 (ESV): "and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, Jesus who delivers us from the wrath to come."

questions.question: Whom did God raise from the dead? He delivers us from the wrath to come.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:10 (ESV): "whom he raised from the dead, Jesus who delivers us from the wrath to come." (Any of these variations map to Jesus/Son in context of the verse).

questions.question: Jesus delivers us from the ____ to come.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:10 (ESV): "Jesus who delivers us from the wrath to come."

questions.question: What three cardinal virtues does Paul mention together in verse 3? Faith, hope, and ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:3 (ESV): "your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Paul constantly remembers their work of faith, labor of love, and steadfastness of hope before whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:3 (ESV): "remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Paul knows that God has ____ them, because the gospel came with power and the Holy Spirit.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 1:4 (ESV): "For we know, brothers loved by God, that he has chosen you,"

key_verse_text: remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
